verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe self-hosting as a single dependency-free binary runnable via cURL, Docker, Homebrew, APT, or source on Linux/macOS/Windows, plus production guidance (reverse proxy, process manager, master key) and Kubernetes Helm charts/Docker images, and community reports confirm real-world self-hosted deployments at scale. Missing for 10: no independent audit of open-source license terms or feature parity vs. cloud version in the evidence pack.
